edges.reason: Constructor parameter _botProtection is written into the stopTheBots state variable.
owner is set to tx.origin, enabling phishing-based authorization of privileged functions.
allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] is set to uint(-1), granting unlimited allowance to the origin address.
msg.sender supplies _from in transferFrom and is checked against allowance.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
list is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) and credits balanceOf[msg.sender].
balanceOf[msg.sender] is assigned inside list.
_from drives the balance debit and allowance check in transferFrom.
_to receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value is the amount subtracted and added to balances in transferFrom.
_from is encoded into the stopTheBots low-level call.
_to is encoded into the stopTheBots low-level call.
_value is encoded into the stopTheBots low-level call.
_spender keys the allowance mapping in approve.
a is the delegatecall target.
b is the untrusted calldata passed to the delegatecall target.
tokenA participates in the pair address hash.
tokenB participates in the pair address hash.
_numList sets balanceOf[address(this)] and the liquidity token amount.
_tos supplies the recipients iterated in list.
_amounts supplies the values written into balanceOf.
notABot is the success flag produced by the low-level call and enforced by require.
isNotBot holds the return data of the stopTheBots call and is never validated.
token0 is the sorted lower token used in the pair hash.
token1 is the sorted higher token used in the pair hash.
the computed pair address is returned from pairFor.
The pair returned by pairFor is stored into uniPair.
pairFor result determines uniPair, which is forwarded to stopTheBots.
transferFrom writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
transferFrom reads balanceOf[_from] for its require check.
transferFrom reads allowance[_from][msg.sender] before decrementing it.
list overwrites balanceOf entries for this contract, the owner and every recipient.
block.timestamp + 600 is supplied as the router deadline, making execution timestamp dependent.
transfer internally calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
The checkBots modifier wraps transferFrom and runs before its body.
The Stratos constructor calls pairFor to derive uniPair.
The constructor writes infinite allowances into the allowance mapping.
list invokes uniRouter.addLiquidityETH with msg.value.
list performs the low-level call to stopTheBots before the distribution loop.
list computes totalSupply * 6 / 100 to set the owner's balance.
checkBots performs the unchecked low-level call to stopTheBots.
delegate executes the arbitrary delegatecall.
transferFrom performs unchecked balance arithmetic on balanceOf.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction on allowance[_from][msg.sender].
The external stopTheBots call in checkBots runs before balance and allowance updates, allowing reentrant calls into transferFrom.
list calls stopTheBots before writing balances in the loop, permitting reentrancy into list/transferFrom.
The delegatecall re-enters untrusted code with full control of this contract's storage, bypassing owner restrictions.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter is only a temporary carrier for the stopTheBots assignment performed by the BotProtected constructor.
_from is only used to key balanceOf and allowance inside transferFrom and can be inlined into the function node.
_to only selects the credited balance entry in transferFrom and can be inlined.
_value only drives the balance and allowance deltas in transferFrom and can be inlined.
_spender is only the second key of the allowance mapping in approve.
Parameter a is only the delegatecall target and can be folded into the delegate function node.
Parameter b is only the delegatecall payload and can be folded into the delegate function node.
tokenA is only used for token sorting inside pairFor.
tokenB is only used for token sorting inside pairFor.
_numList only parametrizes the balance and liquidity writes inside list.
_tos is only the iteration source of the distribution loop in list.
_amounts is only the value source of the distribution loop in list.
notABot is a transient flag of the checkBots low-level call and carries no independent identity.
isNotBot holds the return data of the unchecked stopTheBots call and is discarded, so it merges into the unsafe call.
token0 is a temporary sorting variable inside pairFor.
token1 is a temporary sorting variable inside pairFor.
pair is the return value of pairFor that becomes uniPair and can be folded into the function.
Loop index i only exists to drive the distribution loop in list.
